title: Berlin university provenance audit for Krefeld 2025 Blaschka lots 26-27
purpose: Separate the Humboldt University Zoologische Lehrsammlung, the Museum für Naturkunde historical collections, and the 2025 Krefeld auction evidence before making any object-level provenance claim.

auction_evidence.object: glass model of a sea anemone
auction_evidence.label_transcription: Zoolog. Institut Universität, Berlin / handwritten botanical designation

auction_evidence.object: glass model of a stinging polyp
auction_evidence.label_transcription: Zoolog. Institut Universität, Berlin / handwritten botanical designation
auction_evidence.condition: Glass case with light use/soiling; small corner crack in top pane and right-side pane; otherwise overall good condition.

collection_history_events_relevant_to_pr.event: Teaching collection founded; material also transferred from the anatomical-zootomical collection.
Large transfer of zoological material from the Zoologisches Museum into the teaching collection.
Decision to reduce the collection. Parts were given away, many specimens were lost, and other parts were transferred by museum staff to the Museum für Naturkunde.
collection_history_events_relevant_to_pr.provenance_significance: This creates a documented dispersal window that could explain how historically labelled teaching material left stable HU custody, but no Krefeld object is yet tied to this event.

label_assessment.finding: The wording on the Krefeld labels is independently documented on objects in the HU Zoologische Lehrsammlung.
label_assessment.limit: A matching label style does not by itself prove that either auction object was part of the surviving/current HU Blaschka group, nor does it supply an inventory number or disposal date.

museum_fuer_naturkunde_branch.relationship: The Museum für Naturkunde zoological collections and the HU Zoologische Lehrsammlung must be kept distinct. HU's collection history states that Schulze created a teaching collection independent of the museum in 1884; later, during the 1970 reduction, some teaching-collection material was transferred to the Museum für Naturkunde.
museum_fuer_naturkunde_branch.runtime_status: PDF target resolved, body not recovered in this pass.
museum_fuer_naturkunde_branch.guard: Do not collapse HU and MfN into one Berlin collection and do not assume a Krefeld object passed through MfN without an object-level crosswalk.

dating_conflict.auction_layer: Krefeld catalogues both lots as around 1870.
dating_conflict.hu_public_object_examples: Current HU Blaschka examples recovered in this pass are dated 1885 or 1887.
dating_conflict.interpretation: The conflict is material and unresolved. The HU collection foundation in 1884 and current 1885/1887 examples make a later date plausible for HU-associated material, but older objects could also have entered a later-founded collection. The auction date must therefore remain unchanged until the objects are identified against a historical inventory or purchase record.

ranked_provenance_hypotheses.hypothesis: Lots 26-27 were once part of the HU Zoologische Lehrsammlung or its Zoologisches Institut teaching stock and later left university custody.
ranked_provenance_hypotheses.basis: Exact institutional label wording plus independently documented HU label style and surviving HU Blaschka models.

ranked_provenance_hypotheses.hypothesis: The objects may have left during or after the documented 1970 downsizing, when some HU teaching material was given away or lost.
ranked_provenance_hypotheses.basis: HU collection biography records a 1970 reduction/dispersal event; no object list or disposal annotation has yet linked these two lots to it.

ranked_provenance_hypotheses.hypothesis: One or both objects may have transferred to the Museum für Naturkunde before later entering the market.
ranked_provenance_hypotheses.basis: HU states some material was transferred to MfN during the 1970 reduction; MfN has a separate OS001-02 Blaschka inventory.

ranked_provenance_hypotheses.hypothesis: The labels could represent another Berlin university zoological-institute stock sequence not represented by the presently indexed HU examples.
ranked_provenance_hypotheses.basis: No auction object-level inventory number has yet been recovered.

next_actions: Search HU historical inventory/acquisition records for sea anemone and stinging-polyp Blaschka entries, including pre-1970 inventory numbers.
Search HU 1968-1970 collection-reduction, gift, transfer and loss documentation before broad auction searching.
Obtain and search MfN OS001-02 for matching taxon, dimensions, label, model number, missing/deaccessioned status or old inventory number.
Compare auction photographs with historical/current HU and MfN photographs only after candidate taxa/model numbers are recovered.
Preserve the circa-1870 auction date as market metadata until an object-level documentary bridge resolves it.
